item.title: Charlotte Wilson is on the rise
item.description: At 20 years of age, Charlotte Wilson has already won a world cup event in dual moguls. item.title: Tess Coady is ready to take the leap
item.description: The 25-year-old snowboarder suffered a devastating injury on the eve of her Olympic debut in 2018, but came back to win bronze at the 2022 Beijing Olympics. item.title: Jakara Anthony is shooting for the stars, again
item.description: In the years since her flawless gold medal run at the 2022 Beijing Winter Olympics, Jakara Anthony has faced a career-altering injury, surgery and the long, slow grind of rebuilding herself from the ground up. Now, Australia’s most dominant moguls skier is going for gold once more The post Jakara Anthony is shooting for the stars, again appeared first on Women's Health Australia.
